mapper.select: SELECT lca.contract_attachment_id, lca.contract_id, lca.withdraw_id, lca.document_name, lca.attachment_code, lca.order_number, ( SELECT wm_concat( faa.file_name ) modelName FROM fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE faam.attachment_id = faa.attachment_id AND faam.table_pk_value = lca.contract_attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'LON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT' ) file_name, lca.description FROM lon_contract_attachment lca WHERE lca.SOURCE_TYPE = 'LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW' and lca.source_id = #{withdrawId}
select nvl(max(lca.order_number),0)+1 order_number from lon_contract_attachment lca where lca.contract_id=#{contractId}

( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sf.file_id, sf.file_name, sf.file_type, sf.file_suffix, sf.upload_date, sf.file_path, sf.file_size, sacb.category_path, lca.attachment_code, lca.order_number FROM lon_contract_attachment lca JOIN sys_file sf ON sf.file_id=lca.source_id JOIN sys_attachment sa ON sf.attachment_id = sa.attachment_id JOIN sys_attach_category_b sacb ON sa.category_id=sacb.category_id WHERE lca.contract_id=#{contractId} ORDER BY lca.order_number, lca.creation_date)) UNION ALL ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sf.file_id, sf.file_name, sf.file_type, sf.file_suffix, sf.upload_date, sf.file_path, sf.file_size, sacb.category_path, ppa.attachment_code, ppa.order_number FROM prj_project_attachment ppa JOIN sys_file sf ON sf.file_id=ppa.source_id AND ppa.project_attachment_category='LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW' JOIN sys_attachment sa ON sf.attachment_id = sa.attachment_id JOIN sys_attach_category_b sacb ON sa.category_id=sacb.category_id JOIN lon_contract_withdraw lcw ON lcw.withdraw_id=ppa.project_id WHERE lcw.contract_id=#{contractId} ORDER BY ppa.order_number, ppa.creation_date ))
select count(1) from lon_contract_attachment lca where lca.attachment_code is null and lca.contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.delete: delete lon_contract_attachment t where t.source_id = #{sourceId} and t.source_type = 'LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW'
